title: Vertex scene document
description: A complete Vertex game world: vector shapes (SVG path data), entities (instances of shapes), and game state. This file is the formal description of the format and doubles as documentation for code generators: a whole game is this object plus systems.

shapes.description: Named vector shapes. Geometry is SVG path data centered on (0,0), facing +x at rotation 0. Keep paths small; prefer M/L/Q/C/Z.

entities.description: Instances of shapes. Plain data: every field is readable and writable by humans, systems, and agents.

state.description: Game-level values (score, lives, ...). state.hud, if present, is rendered as text by both renderers.

shape.description: One path with style, or a composite of parts.

d.description: SVG path data. Supports M/L/H/V/C/S/Q/T/A/Z, absolute and relative.

clip.description: SVG path data; the part is clipped to this region (local coords).

parts.description: Multiple paths drawn together as one shape, in order.

gradient.description: Linear (x1,y1 -> x2,y2) or radial (cx,cy,r) gradient in local shape coordinates.

entity.description: An instance of a shape in the world.

id.description: Unique id. Auto-assigned (e1, e2, ...) if omitted.

shape.description: Name of a shape defined in shapes.

d.description: Inline geometry (SVG path data) instead of a named shape; may change every step (morphs, generated art).

drag.description: Velocity damping fraction per second, 0..1 (used by the motion system).

tags.description: System selectors: 'wrap' wraps at edges, other tags pair up in collide().

data.description: Free-form per-entity values. data.ttl (seconds) despawns the entity via the lifetime system.
